key_claims: across all tasks, the model outperforms classical baselines and achieves performance comparable to the foundation model.
furthermore, we examine data scalability and observe consistent but gradually diminishing improvements as the training set increases from 1% to 50%.
finally, although lightweight downstream models improve interpretability and stability, they may limit performance ceilings compared to task-specific end-to-end optimisation.
